name: Per-seat price stepper
definition: Seat counter with minus and plus buttons that recalculates the total and applies volume discounts at stated thresholds.
bestUse: Per-user pricing where team size changes the unit price.

demo.how: The visitor sets the team size and sees the unit price and total update, with the next discount threshold named so a bigger plan feels earned rather than hidden. Use the minus and plus buttons or type a number. The discount steps at 10 and 50 seats; prices are illustrative.
